surface: Internal package consumer and external independent durable-data controller
xmlDocumentation: ApiProbe.csproj emits XML; internal implementation comments identify ownership and oracle boundaries

nativeMapping.database: Public DataSource/DataSession/transaction/query/relation APIs -> existing database ABI -> Rust SQLx/SeaQuery and real SQLite/PostgreSQL
nativeMapping.http: Public NativeServer and ServerRequest/ServerResponse -> existing Server ABI -> Rust Hyper/Axum/Tokio/rustls
nativeMapping.grpc: Static application message marshaller and public gRPC calls -> existing Tonic host; raw real HTTP2 client checks independent frames/metadata
nativeMapping.mcp: Source-generated JSON and public MCP registry -> existing Rust MCP host; actual business callback performs native database query
nativeMapping.resourceObservation: Public close results, explicit weak-reference/disposal witnesses, and fixed database diagnostic export; no aggregate managed-root claim

platformScope: Linux x64 JIT and explicit-RID NativeAOT; Windows is not executed
acceptance: Actual public API rows supplement B22. They never replace external fault, long-duration, independent review, or B24 pristine gates.
